mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies at Verona City Hall with a temperature of 67 degrees. The ISS will pass overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

Important construction alert: Hwy M near the future Aldi location will be closed from October 5 to October 7 for asphalt and shoulder work, with traffic detoured to Old PB and Verona Avenue. Also, remember that the City of Verona only accepts check payments for planning fees delivered to the City Administration Building.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Today, check out the Verona Fall Fest at Hometown USA Festival Park or catch live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard. Tomorrow, the Dane County Farmers' Market takes over the Capitol Square.
For our weekly report, on September 10, officers responded to a burglary in progress at Hunters Cove Way, where a suspect was detained following a gunshot and physical injury during the break-in.
Culver's of Verona is currently closed for a remodeling project, but you can look forward to the OREO REESE'S Cheesecake flavor coming when they reopen.
